title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Pass — a kitchen-expo operator page. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Navigation stays a normal sidebar either way; the world is type, palette, density, and one signature move.

options.label: The Pass
options.thesis: Things that need you hang at the pass; everything else waits on the board.
options.viewport: Navy section rail on the left. Under the header, a pass of tickets: people waiting, scheduler stale. Overview numbers sit below, not above.
options.risk: An empty pass becomes a blank hero. Collapse it to one line when nothing is waiting.

raised.raise: Disabled invite codes stay on the list as voided stubs; they never disappear.
Disable sits alone, never next to Copy or Create.
Waiting, granted, and stale are solid, dashed, and half-height marks — color is backup.
The one thing that outranks its neighbors is a doubled mark, not a louder color.
Opening a person fills the work area; the rail stays, the rest of the board yields.

options.label: Heat Sheet
options.thesis: The beta as a printed heat: names, status, highlighter on who needs you.
options.viewport: Black condensed type on newsprint. A yellow highlight stripe sits on the waiting row. Overview is a dense results sheet, not a card grid.
options.risk: Also the direction most operator-dashboard runs land on: dense table, condensed type, yellow selection.

options.label: Acetate Tabs
options.thesis: Each job dyes the rail; you always know which section you are in from across the room.
options.viewport: Oxide-orange rail because Overview is open. Milk work area. One board hue at a time, never a rainbow of tabs.
options.case: Holds product clarity: color-coded sections make jumping faster. Loses audience identification — a fueling-app owner does not live in a software manual.
options.risk: Six loud section hues become decoration if the rail is not one board color at a time.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Access as coupons: mint, validate, void. Nothing is deleted; it is stamped.
options.viewport: Navy shell, red primary, invite codes as fare coupons.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity: an airline wallet is not a gym-fueling owner’s world, and a coupon book would slow jumping.
options.kept: Cancelled state stamps; disabled codes never vanish.
options.risk: Reads as a travel product the moment red bars and VOID marks take over.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Hairline panels on graphite; delete lives in empty space.
options.viewport: Dark tiled panels, compact sans, isolated destructive action.
options.case: Loses both axes: it is a costume of a tool, and it is the look this page already has.
options.kept: Isolate destructive actions with empty space.
options.risk: A prettier version of tonight’s dashboard.

options.label: Labanotation
options.thesis: Time rises; shape is direction; fill is level.
options.viewport: A vertical staff of days with hatched under-target blocks.
options.case: Loses both: a dance score is not this owner’s world, and a vertical staff is not a working admin page.
options.kept: Status in fill pattern, not hue alone.
options.risk: Reads as a diagram of the product instead of the product.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One person owns the viewport; the next is already loaded.
options.viewport: A single person profile filling the screen.
options.case: Loses both: jumping between jobs dies if only one item can be on screen.
options.kept: Opening a person fills the work area.
options.risk: Turns an operator page into a viewer.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: State is line height, dash, and doubling — colour is a wavelength, not a mood.
options.viewport: Dark plate, KPIs as bright lines on a continuum.
options.case: Loses audience identification, and a spectrogram costume would hide the task.
options.kept: The thing that outranks its neighbors is a doubled mark.
options.risk: Looks like lab software the owner does not run.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A light SaaS admin: sidebar, KPI row, charts, table — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: White work area, gray rail, blue primary, four equal KPI cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Linear or Stripe Atlas by design.
